BusyBox for Windows (busybox-w32) is bundled so this app can run a Unix-style
shell on Windows without WSL.

Binary: https://frippery.org/busybox/
Source: https://github.com/rmyorston/busybox-w32
License: GPL-2.0 (same as BusyBox)

Git for Windows MinGit is downloaded at build time and bundled with the app.

https://github.com/git-for-windows/git
License: GPL-2.0
